mainProducerCategory.label: Main producer category
mainProducerCategory.tooltip:
This will be used as the parameter of the {{ProdLinks}} template on the producer page, which will link to the producer's songs list category on the wiki

Click on the "Fetch discography from wiki" button to get this site to query the list of song & album pages from the producer category on VOCALOID Lyrics Wiki.

Use the toggle option on the right to split the album discography into "Original Albums" and "Compilation Albums".

producerMiscAlias.label: Producer's other aliases
producerMiscAlias.tooltip:
The producer's other aliases, if exists. List each item using a semi-colon (;)

This will be used for the {{pwt alias}} template.

affiliations.label: Affiliations
affiliations.tooltip:
Is the producer affiliated with any circle/group/project?

Add one affiliation per line.

labels.label: Labels
labels.tooltip:
What labels (e.g. KarenT, Exit Tunes) is the producer usually affliated with?

Add one label/affiliation per line.

languages.label: Languages
languages.tooltip: What language does the producer like to write their songs in? e.g. Japanese, English

usesSynths.label: Uses the synthesizers
usesSynths.tooltip: What voice synthesizer group/software family/engine does the producer like to write their songs with? e.g. VOCALOID, UTAU

producerRoles.label: Typical roles
producerRoles.tooltip: Describe the producer's typical roles, e.g. composer, lyricist, illustrator.

externalLinks.label: External links
externalLinks.tooltip:
Examples of media links:
  • The producer's official Niconico/YouTube/bilibili accounts.
  • The producer's NND MyList.
  • The producer's piapro.
  • The producer's account on SoundCloud/Netease Music.
  • The producer's Bandcamp/Spotify/TuneCore/other music streaming.
Examples of official links:
  • The producer's official website.
  • The producer's social media/SNS accounts, e.g. Twitter, Instagram, Weibo.
Examples of unofficial links:
  • The producer's page on VocaDB.
  • A page on the producer from any unofficial wiki, e.g. the VOCALOID wiki, the Hatsune Miku wiki, Nicopedia, etc.

discographySongs.label: List of songs
discographySongs.tooltip:
Add the list of song pages (that exist on the VOCALOID Lyrics wiki) here.

You can copy and paste the page URL to add the pages automatically.

discographyAlbums.label: List of albums
discographyAlbums.tooltip:
Add the list of album pages (that exist on the VOCALOID Lyrics wiki) here.

You can copy and paste the page URL to add the pages automatically.
discographyAlbums.fetchFromWikiNote:
Use the "Fetch discography from wiki" button to get the song & album pages that have been tagged in Vocaloid Lyrics wiki.

Alternatively, you can use the Category Tree tool on the Vocaloid Lyrics wiki to manually get the list of song & album pages. See this example for PinocchioP.

Do note that the Category Tree tool can only query a maximum of 200 pages per category.
